messages:
Ada Park: Quick UX check: the new structured-output / tool-calling flow in the playground is shaping up but the function inspector expands and shifts the run history. Hard to compare runs quickly. Anyone else see this?

Rafael Gomez: Yep — losing vertical context is the issue. Could we show a compact one-line summary for each fn (name + type badges + chevron) and expand into an overlay anchored to that row? That would keep the history static.

June Li: Overlay is fine but watch keyboard flows. Escape should close overlay and focus should return to the run entry. I prefer an inline absolute panel that overlays the schema area (no page reflow).

Marco Chen: Small copy nit: unify verbs. We have "Run", "Invoke", and "Execute" in different places. Vote for "Run" to match console.

Ada Park: Agreed on "Run". Also, the schema label sometimes says "Schema (auto-detect)", other times "Inferred schema". Suggest: "Schema preview 1 inferred" (use em dash) and when inference fails show "Couldn't infer schema. Edit to continue."

Rafael Gomez: Run history idea: surface param-type chips (TXT/NUM/FILE) inline next to truncated args. Use 12	616px icons with short alt text. Chips speed scanning.

June Li: Accessibility rules: chips must have aria-label like "title: text" and be focusable when a run entry is focused. Preview-expand should not steal focus; edit-expand should move focus to the first editable input. Also make the expand control's aria-label verbose: "Expand schema for function SummarizeText".

UXBot: Filed issue #812: "playground-inspector-a11y". Acceptance criteria: 1) verbose aria-labels for expand controls 2) preview-expand leaves focus unchanged 3) edit-expand moves focus to primary input 4) param chips have aria-labels and are keyboard-focusable.

Marco Chen: Keyboard shortcut: bind `R` for Run in the playground and show "Press R to run" tooltip on the Run button. Add entry to help overlay (Press ? for shortcuts).

Ada Park: For compact mode: default to collapsed to prioritize density during dev loops. Auto-expand for first-time users by checking a local flag. Store preference in localStorage initially, then mirror to account settings later.

Rafael Gomez: Runtime caveat: collapsing result previews must not evict ephemeral KV cache needed for replay. I'll open a runtime ticket and link it here.

June Li: Visual guidance: chips should be low-contrast background with 16px line-height, icon left, 2-3 char label. Hover reveals full value in tooltip. No motion for SR users; keep preview-expand animated (fade+scale) and edit-expand instant.

Marco Chen: Quick poll: prefer "Run" or "Invoke" across the app? React with :one: for Run, :two: for Invoke.

Ada Park: :one:

Rafael Gomez: :one:

June Li: :one:

UXBot: Poll closed: 3 votes for "Run". Recorded to style guide.

Ada Park: TODOs: [Rafael] runtime KV ticket, [June] accessibility labels & focus tests, [Marco] copy PR to standardize "Run", [Ada] interaction spec + prototype (I'll drop a figma link).

Rafael Gomez: Opened runtime ticket #813 and linked this thread.

June Li: I'll add unit tests for focus order and aria-labels in the playground test harness.

Marco Chen: I'll open a small copy PR to replace "Invoke/Execute" with "Run" and update the tooltip text.

Ada Park: Prototype link: https://figma.example/redwood/playground-inspector-proto. Will post before EOD for review. Thanks all :thumbsup:

UXBot: Added TODOs to project board and linked prototype when available.
